subject.title: fix: compaction usage guards and agent-loop turn correctness

question: Should session per-turn refresh introduce the new public `AgentOptions.prepareNextTurnWithContext` callback, or should the fix remain internal or extend the existing hook without a parallel public API?
rationale: The branch regenerates the public plugin SDK baseline, and choosing the permanent callback contract is an API ownership decision that cannot be safely inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Split Public API From Fixes
options.body: Land the internal compaction and loop corrections separately, then evaluate the new callback in a focused API proposal with compatibility evidence.

options.title: Approve Additive Callback
options.body: Keep `prepareNextTurnWithContext` after documenting precedence, compatibility expectations, and focused tests for consumers that define either or both hooks.

recommendation.title: Split Public API From Fixes
recommendation.body: Land the internal compaction and loop corrections separately, then evaluate the new callback in a focused API proposal with compatibility evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this person as the strongest owner for compaction and session-runtime direction, and they are assigned to the PR.
